title: Michael Vernard “Mike” Thompson: January, 3, 1953 – June, 25, 2026
description: Michael Vernard “Mike” Thompson, 73, of Anchorage, Alaska, passed away peacefully at home on June 25, 2026. Born January 3, 1953, in Tillamook County, Oregon, Mike arrived in Alaska as a young child in 1956 and made the state his lifelong home. His family has deep roots in Alaska dating back to 1898. He spent his childhood and youth in Sitka and Seward, graduating from Seward High School with the Class of 1971. After a brief period in Washington, he returned to Alaska and settled permanently in Anchorage.
